headline: 16,000+ police deployed as idol immersion ceremonies take place at 33 points in Dhaka
summary: Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) has implemented maximum security measures to ensure the smooth completion of the Durga Puja immersion process.
details: Over 16,000 police personnel have been deployed across various locations in the capital city to ensure the process of idol immersion is completed without any disruption.
Joint Commissioner (Operations) of the Dhaka Metropolitan Police, Md. Shahidullah Amin, announced that the ceremonies will take place at 33 designated points across the city.
The Wiseghat area is expected to see the highest volume of immersion activities.
Speaking to reporters at Polashi Moore on Wednesday, the police official stated that the Durga Puja celebrations have remained peaceful so far with no unpleasant incidents reported.
The DMP has requested the cooperation of city residents to ensure the entire process of concluding the Puja festivities is completed safely and smoothly.
caption:
16,000+ police personnel are on high alert in Dhaka to secure 33 idol immersion points.

Over 16,000 police personnel have been deployed across various locations in the capital city to ensure the process of idol immersion is completed without any disruption.

The Wiseghat area is expected to see the highest volume of immersion activities.

Speaking to reporters at Polashi Moore on Wednesday, the police official stated that the Durga Puja celebrations have remained peaceful so far with no unpleasant incidents reported.

The DMP has requested the cooperation of city residents to ensure the entire process of concluding the Puja festivities is completed safely and smoothly.

headline: Tk 28.11bn spent: Govt scraps Gazipur BRT project after 14 years
summary: The unfinished project, which faced five deadline extensions, will be converted into a six-lane highway to utilize existing structures.
details: The government has officially scrapped the Bus Rapid Transit (BRT) project from Dhaka airport to Gazipur, 14 years after its inception in December 2012. The decision was made during a cabinet meeting presided over by Prime Minister Tarique Rahman on October 18.
caption:
Tk 28.11 billion spent, 14 years of waiting, and five deadline extensions—but no buses ever ran. The Gazipur BRT is officially dead.

The government has officially scrapped the Bus Rapid Transit (BRT) project from Dhaka airport to Gazipur, 14 years after its inception in December 2012. The decision was made during a cabinet meeting presided over by Prime Minister Tarique Rahman on October 18.
